answer_4.guideline: We instruct them by defining a good text paragraph as being: • Fluent: Should have no obviously ungrammatical sentences, missing components, etc. that make the text difficult to read. • Coherent: Should stay on topic with the prompt and build from sentence to sentence to a coherent body of information. • Informative: Should have diverse and interesting content. • Sensical: Should generally make sense.
